info.title: Expenditure API
info.description: Personal API keys authorize personal expense automation and self-paid Circle expense creation. Circle management, reads and split edits require a normal PocketBase users session in the Authorization header. Ownership, membership, currency precision, splits, and settlements are validated on the server. Requests and stored records use amount (integer currency minor units) and payment_method. Field aliases are not accepted. Income uses positive amounts and kind=income; spending reports and budgets include expenses only. Recurring income and expenses run on the PocketBase server every minute, with custom intervals and monthly dates, catching up after downtime. Schedule edits affect future copies; stopping or deleting the original preserves generated entries.

post.description: Requires expenses:write. Idempotency-Key is optional and scoped to the user. For 24 hours from the original server-created timestamp, identical data replays the existing expense and different data conflicts. After expiry, even identical data creates a new expense; old expenses are retained. Retries and edits do not extend the window. Use a timestamp plus a random number per purchase, retained for retries. Omit user.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Fixed 24-hour retry protection. Generate once per purchase and reuse only for that payload. Expiry is based on server creation time, not occurred_at. After expiry a late retry can create a duplicate.

patch.summary: Author or owner: edit a recorded repayment
patch.description: Updates a recorded external repayment without transferring money. Requires its current version. The original author or Circle owner may edit. Financial changes by a non-owner require that author to remain a participant in the replacement; metadata-only edits retain author access. Financial changes are validated against current balances with the original repayment reversed, so they cannot overpay or mix currencies. Former members balances cannot change. The ID, original creator and creation timestamp are retained. Omitted notes and occurred_at retain their previous values. Notes/date-only edits remain allowed after later ledger changes. Balances and repayment suggestions are recalculated from the saved ledger.

get.summary: Get monthly spending and income totals
get.description: Aggregates all matching personal expenses and the requesting user's positive allocated shares of Circle expenses, regardless of who paid. Uses the expense instant and supplied account-timezone month boundaries, including historical shares for inactive memberships. Moved personal receipts are excluded to prevent double counting. Circle categories match personal categories by exact name, then by a unique case/whitespace-insensitive name; unmatched or ambiguous names count as the personal Other category or a report-only Other bucket. Split edits update consumption without creating personal transactions or changing Circle balances. Circle income and repayments do not consume budgets. Native personal collection lists remain personal-only. The Transactions page and its exports can use the preference-aware combined transaction feed.

post.summary: Move an owned personal expense to a Circle
post.description: Every active member may transfer their own expense. Income cannot be moved. Atomically excludes the original from the personal ledger and creates a Circle expense with the same ID, amount, currency, occurrence, created/updated timestamps, notes, payment method and provenance. Payer and author are the moving membership ID. Initial percentage split is 10000 basis points to that member, adding no debt. Recurrence and its saved timezone, anchor, next cursor and pause state transfer intact; existing generated personal entries stay in place. Retries to the same Circle return the existing entry without duplicating or overwriting it. A retained owner-protected receipt preserves API idempotency for the original 24-hour window, even if the Circle entry is later deleted. Transfers do not return to the personal ledger when a Circle is deleted.

401.description: Authentication required

403.description: Transfer requires an active Circle membership.

404.description: Circle or record not found

post.summary: Add a self-paid Circle expense using an API key
post.description: Requires expenses:write in X-API-Key and active membership in the Circle. The key and membership are checked inside the creation transaction. Only the key owner can be the payer and sole initial share member. Other Circle routes remain session-only. source is api. Idempotency-Key replay protection is not supported; each successful request creates an entry.

get.summary: List personal transactions with optional allocated Circle entries
get.description: Session-only feed controlled by the requesting account show_circle_transactions preference. Positive own Circle expense and income shares are included when enabled, regardless of payer, including retained inactive membership history. Zero/unallocated entries, repayments and moved personal receipts are excluded. Filtering, counts and descending occurred_at/created/collectionName/id ordering apply to the complete combined dataset before pagination. Native record fields remain unchanged: Circle amount is the full original amount; allocated_amount is the account share; budget_category maps the Circle category to the personal account. No personal record copies or financial mutations are made. Personal automation read scopes do not grant access.

currency.description: A supported uppercase currency code enabled in the user account. Defaults to the user main currency only when omitted; null, empty strings and non-string values are rejected.

category.description: A non-empty string naming an active category belonging to the user; surrounding whitespace is trimmed and matching is case-insensitive. Defaults to active Other, otherwise the first active category, only when omitted.

occurred_at.description: Defaults to server time; include Z or a timezone offset when supplied.

notes.description: Optional text, preserved as supplied, up to 2000 characters. Defaults to an empty string.

idempotency_expires_at.description: POST responses only: fixed retry-window end in UTC, 24 hours after server creation; null when the request had no Idempotency-Key. Retries do not extend this timestamp.

kind.description: Positive amount with an explicit direction. For Circle income, paid_by is the recipient who owes each member their allocated share.

recurrence.description: Empty disables recurrence for expenses or income. The original entry holds the schedule; generated copies have empty recurrence and zero interval/day fields. Enabling, changing or resuming a paused schedule starts at its next future occurrence after both the entry and the current time; active schedules catch up after downtime. Days/weeks retain the original weekday and wall-clock time in the saved timezone. Monthly and yearly dates clamp to shorter months without losing their anchor.

recurrence_interval.description: Repeat every N days, weeks, months or years. Active schedules store 1 to 365; omitted or zero selects 1. Disabled schedules and generated entries store 0.

recurrence_day.description: Monthly schedules only: 0 keeps the original calendar day, -1 selects the last day of each scheduled month, and 1 to 31 selects that day (clamped in shorter months). A chosen day can generate later in the original month; custom intervals are anchored to that month. Other frequencies require 0.

recurrence_timezone.description: Account timezone captured when the schedule starts.

recurrence_anchor.description: Original local calendar date/time; month ends clamp without losing this day.

recurrence_next.description: Next occurrence as an ISO instant, or empty when disabled.

recurrence_error.description: Non-empty means generation is paused. Resolve the issue and save the schedule to retry.

PersonalEntryInput.description: Native owner-protected expenses collection input. Recurrence metadata is managed by the server. The API-key automation endpoint accepts ExpenseInput only.

Overview.description: Complete-dataset monthly spending and personal income summary. total, previous, count, categories, activity and original_totals include personal expenses plus the user's positive allocated Circle expense shares. Circle categories use matching personal category names, falling back to Other. Personal income is reported separately; Circle income and repayments are excluded. Currency conversions are reference estimates rounded per personal expense or allocated share.

previous_updated.description: Exact updated value from the personal record, checked inside the transaction.

category.description: Active category name in the destination Circle.

CircleCategoryCopy.description: Owner-only replacement from the authenticated owner personal settings. Copies names, colours, active status and order. Reuses matching Circle category IDs, removes unused unmatched categories, and archives unmatched categories used in history. Historical entries, monetary amounts and balances are preserved. The combined list is limited to 100 categories.

CircleApiExpenseInput.description: Creates an expense as the API key owner, who must be an active Circle member. paid_by and created_by are that membership ID. A percentage split assigns 10000 basis points (100%) and the entire amount to that same member, initially creating no shared debt. Payer, shares, split_mode, kind, recurrence and provenance fields are server-managed and rejected in requests. Edit allocations through the authenticated website.

CircleSettlementEdit.description: Replacement payer, recipient, currency and amount with the current version. Omitted notes and occurred_at preserve their saved values.

allocated_amount.description: The requesting account allocated share, in original currency minor units. Original amount remains the full Circle transaction amount.

budget_category.description: Matching personal category name or Other, using the same mapping as budgets.

membership_active.description: Whether the requesting account membership remains active. Inactive historical shares are readable but do not grant current Circle access.

input_mode.description: Subtotals require exactly one item per participant, assigned only to that member.

members.description: Circle membership IDs. Each line total is divided equally among these members with deterministic rounding.

discount.description: Discount in minor units, smaller than subtotal. Distributed proportionally before calculating charges.

service_rate_bp.description: 1000 = 10%. Applied to the discounted subtotal excluding included GST.

service_amount.description: Printed service charge in minor units, or null to calculate using the rate. Zero explicitly waives the charge.

gst_rate_bp.description: 900 = 9%. Added GST applies to discounted items plus service. Included GST is extracted from item prices; added service incurs additional GST.

gst_amount.description: Printed added GST amount, or null for automatic calculation. Must be null for included or no GST.

adjustment.description: Signed final adjustment for receipt rounding or other fees. Distributed proportionally; total must stay positive and shares non-negative.

CircleReceipt.description: Saved receipt calculation for expense entries with exact splits. The server recomputes amount and shares and rejects mismatches. At most 50 participants across all items. No floating-point money; all money is in currency minor units. Charges use receipt-level half-up rounding and deterministic largest-remainder allocation.
